title: Lazy routes not recognized when using array import

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

body:
## I'm submitting a ... 

[ ] Regression (behavior that used to work and stopped working in a new release)
[x] Bug report 
[ ] Feature request
[ ] Documentation issue or request
[ ] Support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
## Current behavior Angular does not recognize lazy routes when they are imported like this: ``` @NgModule({ exports: [RouterModule], imports: [ [RouterModule.forRoot(routes)] ] }) export AppRoutingModule {} ``` _(See more motivation below)_ ## Expected behavior Lazy loaded routes are recognized with the entire syntax that Angular supports (including imports with arrays). ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions Plunkr does not work well for this issue, but I created a small ng-cli repo here: https://github.com/csvn/ng-lazy-route-issue 1. Clone and npm install 2. Start with `npm start` 3. Clicking on the 'lazy' link will display error ## What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior? The example above is contrived, but the use case I have is that I want to define routes in a library module that is imported with `forRoot()`. I tried to have the `forRoot()` method return an array of imports, but this broke the lazy routes. I wanted to do this because the library will wrap the routes in a common parent that has some auth related functionality and more. There are many examples where an array of `imports/providers/exports/declarations/etc` are used, e.g.: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/forms/src/form_providers.ts#L23. The `NgModule` class in Typescript also specify that `any[]` may be used for most fields: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/core/src/metadata/ng_module.ts#L132. If an app is started with `imports: [RouterModule.forRoot(routes)]`, and then changed to `imports: [ [RouterModule.forRoot(routes)] ]` everything will still work fine, as the chunk is already created. So there doesn't seem to be any issues running with the latter syntax, just for recognizing lazy routes. The reason chunks won't be created due to `__NGTOOLS_PRIVATE_API_2.listLazyRoutes()` (from `@angular/compiler-cli`) not finding any lazy routes. I am not sure if this is also the issue for when using `ng build --aot`, as it has the same issue as JIT. ## Please tell us about your environment
